name: C061 Tu Sĩ Hắc Ám (Trượng Lồng Đèn Cứu Rỗi)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Support Healer's lantern staff (Trượng Lồng Đèn Cứu Rỗi - C061 Tu Sĩ Hắc Ám) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete wrought-iron monk staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (iron butt cap and wrapped leather shaft) to top-right (hooked iron crook suspending a glowing golden-white sanctuary lantern that radiates warm healing light).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top lantern crook with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use dark forged iron, aged oak wood, warm brass, and golden-amber healing lantern glow).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Sanctuary Lantern Staff (Trượng Lồng Đèn Cứu Rỗi - C061 Tu Sĩ Hắc Ám) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the wrought-iron monk staff with its hanging golden-white sanctuary lantern diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a shadowy gothic chapel nave where warm golden-white rays of salvation light stream out from the lantern, banishing dark mist.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
